summary: Rithm Property Trust Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that a wholly-owned subsidiary consummated the purchase of a portfolio of multifamily residential transition loans from Genesis Capital LLC, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Rithm Capital Corp. The purchase was executed under a Flow Mortgage Loan Purchase and Sale Agreement with Rithm Loan Aggregation Trust, an affiliate of the Company's external manager. The agreement allows for periodic purchases of loans that meet eligibility criteria, with the Company engaging Genesis as servicer. No specific purchase price, premium, or shareholder vote is mentioned. The filing indicates a related-party transaction but lacks material deal terms. The purchase is effective May 13, 2026.
